events.body:
## Context

The BLT entry's `repo_url` is `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/BLT-Core`, but `check_funding_file` builds `raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{repo}/master/...` from the last two path parts, so it fetches the wrong host. Only `master` is tried, so main-branch repos are missed. The real file is `blt-core/.github/FUNDING.yml`.

## What to do

1. Allow an optional `funding_url` per extra project (for BLT, the forge raw URL of `blt-core/.github/FUNDING.yml`).
2. For GitHub repos, use `default_branch` from the API instead of `master`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] BLT appears with its owasp.org donate link
- [ ] Main-branch repos with FUNDING.yml are found
- [ ] No raw.githubusercontent.com URL for the BLT forge in the run log

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-tomato && GITHUB_TOKEN=<your token> OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/t python3 .github/scripts/funding/owasp_funding_yml_scraper.py
```

---
